name: Mayaoa Enasa
source:
A girl [url=/c124122]Futaba[/url] meets on the planet he crash landed on.
She is diplomatic and has a cheerful personality. She has a secret that she keeps well.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050312000200/http://www.h7.dion.ne.jp/~nagikaze/enrai.html#no_2]official website[/url].]
